correctness.rationale: The two independent torus characters force monomials a^k orthogonal to (s,p)-multiples; this makes E_m reducing for M_a. Explicit Haar moment h_j=binom(2j,j)/4^j yields normalized shift weights h_(m+k+1)/h_(m+k)=(2(m+k)+1)/(2(m+k)+2). Difference of successive weights proves d_(m,0) and d_(m,k)=1/[2(m+k)(m+k+1)] for k≥1, including m=0 boundary. The tail is k^-2/2, giving S_q exactly q>1/2, log residue 1/sqrt(2), and telescoping trace 1. The generating-function coefficient recurrence and first-order ODE give the arcsine formula; m=1,2 kernels follow by a finite-tail identity. Statements are for restricted operators, not [M_a*,M_a] on the full H_m.
